### PCIe Topology Diagram
```
AMD EPYC 7343 (2-socket, AMD Milan)
├── Root Complex 0x00  (NUMA 0)
│   └── [01:xx] BlueField-3 ConnectX-7 NIC
├── Root Complex 0x40  (NUMA 0)
│   └── [41:00.0] GPU 0: NVIDIA A30  (Gen4 x16)
├── Root Complex 0x60  (NUMA 0/1)
│   ├── [61:00.0] NVMe drive-0      (Gen4 x4)
│   ├── [62:00.0] NVMe drive-1      (Gen4 x4)
│   ├── [63:00.0] NVMe drive-2      (Gen4 x4)
│   └── [64:00.0] NVMe drive-3      (Gen4 x4)
├── Root Complex 0xa0  (NUMA 1)
│   └── [a1:00.0] GPU 1: NVIDIA A30  (Gen4 x16)
└── Root Complex 0xc0  (NUMA 1)
    ├── [c1:00.0] NVMe drive-4      (Gen4 x4)
    ├── [c2:00.0] NVMe drive-5      (Gen4 x4)
    └── [c3:00.0] NVMe drive-6      (Gen4 x4)
```

> **AMD EPYC note:** All PCIe root complexes are integrated into the CPU die. Every
> device-to-device transfer (NVMe DMA → GPU BAR1) traverses the Infinity Fabric regardless
> of root-complex proximity. There is no "same-root shortcut" as on Intel platforms.
> NUMA locality matters: drives and GPUs on the same socket/die see lower overhead.

## 6. Path 4 — GDRCopy BAR1 Bandwidth (CPU ↔ GPU)

Testing GPU 0 (41:00.0). `gdrdrv` and `nvidia_peermem` both loaded.

### gdrcopy_copybw (size = 128 KiB)
| Direction | Bandwidth |
|-----------|-----------|
| CPU → BAR1 (write) | **11,776 MB/s ≈ 11.78 GB/s** |
| CPU ← BAR1 (read) | **20.4 MB/s ≈ 0.020 GB/s** |

BAR1 reads are ~0.02 GB/s — expected; uncacheable PCIe reads suffer severe read amplification.  
BAR1 writes use write-combining (WC) mappings: 11.78 GB/s is fast and well above metadata needs.

### gdrcopy_copylat (CPU → BAR1 write latency)
| Size | Avg Latency |
|------|-------------|
| 1–64 B | ~0.58 µs |
| 4 KiB | 0.75 µs |
| 64 KiB | 4.92 µs |
| 128 KiB | 12.66 µs |
| 512 KiB | 50.24 µs |

> **Certus context:** GDRCopy is used for **mapping setup only** (gdr_pin_buffer + gdr_map +
> spdk_mem_register). NVMe DMA targets the BAR1-mapped GPU memory directly through the PCIe
> fabric — the CPU never touches the data path. The 11.78 GB/s write bandwidth confirms the
> BAR1 aperture is healthy and the WC mapping is working.

## 10. Path 8 — NVMe DMA → BAR1 (nvme-bar1-bench)

Direct SPDK FFI path — no actor/channel overhead. 2 GiB per drive per iteration (bypasses drive cache).  
Drive selection: first N drives by PCI address order:
drive-0=61:00.0, drive-1=62:00.0, drive-2=63:00.0, drive-3=64:00.0, drive-4=c1:00.0, drive-5=c2:00.0, drive-6=c3:00.0.

### GPU 0 (0000:41:00.0, root 0x40, NUMA 0)

| Config | Drives | QD | host-ram (GB/s) | BAR1 (GB/s) | Overhead |
|--------|--------|----|----------------|-------------|---------|
| 1 drive | 61:00.0 | 16 | 4.07 | 4.09 | ~0% |
| 4 drives | 61–64 | 32 | 22.70 | 18.59 | **18.1%** |
| 6 drives | 61–64, c1–c2 | 32 | 33.98 | 21.37 | **37.1%** |

### GPU 1 (0000:a1:00.0, root 0xa0, NUMA 1)

| Config | Drives | QD | host-ram (GB/s) | BAR1 (GB/s) | Overhead |
|--------|--------|----|----------------|-------------|---------|
| 4 drives (cross-root) | 61–64 | 32 | 22.63 | 21.69 | **4.2%** |
| 3 drives (same-NUMA) | c1–c3 | 32 | 17.01 | 16.52 | **2.9%** |

### Key Findings

- **1 drive: 0% BAR1 overhead.** Single-drive DMA at ~4 GB/s leaves BAR1 uncongested.
- **4 drives → GPU 0: 18% overhead.** Cross-root + cross-NUMA penalty (RC 0x60 → RC 0x40).
- **6 drives → GPU 0: 37% overhead, BAR1 saturated at ~21 GB/s.** Adding more drives yields no gain.
- **4 drives → GPU 1: only 4% overhead** (22.63 → 21.69 GB/s). NUMA-adjacent path significantly better.
- **3 same-NUMA drives → GPU 1: only 3% overhead.** Best topology on this machine.
- **Sanity check:** 1-drive host-ram (4.07 GB/s) is 32% below SPDK perf (5.94 GB/s). Microbenchmark
  adds overhead (per-qpair poller amortization). The relative host-ram vs BAR1 comparison is valid;
  absolute numbers conservatively understate the hardware ceiling.

## 12. Observations and Recommendations

### P2P Cold Path

The practical P2P ceiling on this node is determined by BAR1 saturation, not NVMe throughput:

- **GPU 0 BAR1 ceiling: ~21 GB/s** (saturates above 4–5 drives)
- **GPU 1 BAR1 ceiling: ~22 GB/s** (4% overhead at 4 drives, better NUMA locality)
- **Recommended target GPU: GPU 1 (a1:00.0)** — 4× lower overhead than GPU 0 at 4-drive scale

### Optimal Drive Configuration

| Goal | Recommendation |
|------|---------------|
| Lowest overhead | 3 drives (c1–c3) → GPU 1: 2.9% overhead, 16.5 GB/s |
| Maximum P2P throughput | 4 drives (any) → GPU 1: 21.7 GB/s, 4% overhead |
| Beyond 4 drives | Diminishing returns; BAR1 saturates near 21–22 GB/s |

### Memory-Tier Hot Path

- Route host→GPU transfers to **GPU 1** for best bandwidth (26.7 GB/s vs 24.0 GB/s)
- Single-stream H2D is adequate — multi-stream adds <0.1 GB/s above 8 MiB transfers
- H2D ceiling (26.7 GB/s) is 3× higher than 4-drive BAR1 ceiling (21.7 GB/s)

### D2D Staging Copy Is Not a Bottleneck

GPU internal D2D bandwidth (~410 GB/s sustained) is 20× faster than the NVMe→BAR1 input rate.
The staging ring copy from BAR1 region → final GPU destination adds negligible latency.
